request.query: Siegel lemma existence of small integer polynomial vanishing to prescribed multiplicity at algebraic points

items.name: MvPolynomial.combinatorial_nullstellensatz_exists_linearCombination
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {σ : Type u_2} [Finite σ] [IsDomain R] (S : σ → Finset R),
  (∀ (i : σ), (S i).Nonempty) →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
      (∀ (x : σ → R), (∀ (i : σ), x i ∈ S i) → (MvPolynomial.eval x) f = 0) →
        ∃ h,
          (∀ (i : σ), ((∏ s ∈ S i, (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.C s)) * h i).totalDegree ≤ f.totalDegree) ∧
            f =
              (Finsupp.linearCombination (MvPolynomial σ R) fun i => ∏ r ∈ S i, (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.C r)) h

items.name: IsAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_coeff_and_aeval_eq_zero
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {s : S},
  IsAlgebraic R s → s ∈ nonZeroDivisors S → ∃ q, q.coeff 0 ≠ 0 ∧ (Polynomial.aeval s) q = 0

items.name: LindemannWeierstrass.exp_polynomial_approx
items.type:
∀ (f : Polynomial ℤ),
  Polynomial.eval 0 f ≠ 0 →
    ∃ c,
      ∀ p > (Polynomial.eval 0 f).natAbs,
        Nat.Prime p →
          ∃ n,
            ¬↑p ∣ n ∧
              ∃ gp,
                gp.natDegree ≤ p * f.natDegree - 1 ∧
                  ∀ {r : ℂ},
                    r ∈ f.aroots ℂ → ‖n • Complex.exp r - p • (Polynomial.aeval r) gp‖ ≤ c ^ p / ↑(p - 1).factorial

items.name: Polynomial.exists_monic_aeval_eq_zero_forall_mem_pow_of_isIntegral
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {I : Ideal R} {x : S},
  IsIntegral (↥(Algebra.adjoin R {x | ∃ r ∈ I, Polynomial.C r * Polynomial.X = x})) (Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X) →
    ∃ p, p.Monic ∧ (Polynomial.aeval x) p = 0 ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ), p.coeff i ∈ I ^ (p.natDegree - i)

items.name: LaurentSeries.exists_Polynomial_intValuation_lt
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (F : PowerSeries K) (η : (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))ˣ),
  ∃ P, (PowerSeries.idealX K).intValuation (F - ↑P) < ↑η

items.name: MvPolynomial.schwartz_zippel_sup_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        p.support.sup fun s => ∑ i, ↑(s i) / ↑(S i).card
